title: Can I BEAT Shotgun King? [RANK 3]
summary: Shotgun King, Rank 3 (white gets one extra rook), using the Solomon shotgun; trying to also unlock the Victoria shotgun (needs 6+ fire range). Clears floors 1-11ish with cards such as 'extra turn when you kill a knight / fire arc -10°', 'Tower rook +4 HP but flip if no pawn', 'pawns can't attack you but flip if a pawn dies', Bloodless Coup, Majestic Censer (+1 ammo max, extra soul slot; enemy queen and king lose HP), Extra Barrel (+1 shell, +7° arc) vs Golden Aging, '+1 move range but flip if no knight', Cardinal, '+2 firepower if your king is on the board edge'. Clears rank 3 on one heart left.
rules: Shotgun King: The Final Checkmate (Steam roguelike). You are the lone black king with a shotgun; white's army (led by the White King) is on each floor's irregular board (holes/gaps possible).

Turn: either move one square like a king, or fire the shotgun (a spread of pellets in the aimed direction with limited range; damage depends on firepower and distance/focus). Moving reloads a shell; reloading without moving can squeeze in one extra shell with some cards.

White pieces move by normal chess rules (one white piece moves per turn, AI-chosen); squares they attack are marked; ending your turn on an attacked square = captured (death) unless protected by a card.

Kill the White King to clear the floor; Throne mode = clear floors 1-12 (or as shown); 'Rank' = difficulty level unlocked after clearing (each rank adds a handicap such as extra white pieces or stronger white strategy).
Between floors you pick one of two card pairs: a black (player) upgrade bundled with a white (enemy) buff, e.g. Holy Gunpowder (+1 firepower) with Cardinal (remove a pawn, add a bishop, -1 max ammo).
Soul cards: killing a piece can grant its 'soul' - a one-shot move as that piece (e.g. soul of the bishop/knight lets your king move like that piece once).
Rank 3 handicap: white gets one extra rook.
White pieces have HP (hearts); the White King and Queen can lose HP via cards.

Cards seen: extra turn when you kill a knight (fire arc -10°); Tower rook +4 HP (flip card if no pawn on board); pawns can't attack you (flip if a pawn is killed); Bloodless Coup; Majestic Censer (+1 ammo max, +1 soul slot) vs queen/king lose HP; Golden Aging (white -1 HP, -1 speed every 10 turns); Extra Barrel (+1 shell, +7° fire arc); move range +1 (flip if no knight on board); Cardinal (white -1 pawn +1 bishop, you -1 max ammo); +2 firepower (flip if your king is not on the board edge); bleeding pieces take extra damage.
'Flip card' = a card turns into its downside when its condition fails.
Unlocking alternate shotguns: Victoria requires 6+ fire range.
